description: Left the factory in 1996; erected on a stele inside the base and unveiled on 1 June 2026 in nose-up take-off attitude, in Escadron de Chasse 3/3 Ardennes markings with code 3-XN, carrying a PDLCT laser designation pod and two drop tanks. The stele honours all airmen who served in the 3e Escadre de Chasse. Reported by the French preservation blog foxalphazoulou.overblog.com in its monthly 'Infos patrimoine' updates (2026).

Displayed inside the base close to the Mirage 2000D stele; freshly repainted in 2026. Reported by the French preservation blog foxalphazoulou.overblog.com in its monthly 'Infos patrimoine' updates (2026).
